SELECT RAWTOHEX( m.MCC_ID) MCC_ID,
      CASE
    WHEN m.MCC IS NOT NULL
         AND TRIM(m.MCC) IS NOT NULL
         AND m.CATEGORY_EN IS NOT NULL
         AND TRIM(m.CATEGORY_EN) IS NOT NULL
         AND m.FINAL_MDR IS NOT NULL
        THEN m.MCC || ' | ' ||
             m.CATEGORY_EN || ' | (' ||
             TO_CHAR(m.FINAL_MDR , 'FM999990.00') || '%)'

    WHEN m.MCC IS NOT NULL
         AND TRIM(m.MCC) IS NOT NULL
         AND m.CATEGORY_EN IS NOT NULL
         AND TRIM(m.CATEGORY_EN) IS NOT NULL
        THEN m.MCC || ' | ' || m.CATEGORY_EN

    WHEN m.MCC IS NOT NULL
         AND TRIM(m.MCC) IS NOT NULL
         AND m.FINAL_MDR IS NOT NULL
        THEN m.MCC || ' | (' ||
             TO_CHAR(m.FINAL_MDR * 100, 'FM999990.00') || '%)'

    WHEN m.MCC IS NOT NULL
         AND TRIM(m.MCC) IS NOT NULL
        THEN m.MCC

    WHEN m.CATEGORY_EN IS NOT NULL
         AND TRIM(m.CATEGORY_EN) IS NOT NULL
         AND m.FINAL_MDR IS NOT NULL
        THEN m.CATEGORY_EN || ' | (' ||
             TO_CHAR(m.FINAL_MDR , 'FM999990.00') || '%)'

    WHEN m.CATEGORY_EN IS NOT NULL
         AND TRIM(m.CATEGORY_EN) IS NOT NULL
        THEN m.CATEGORY_EN

    WHEN m.FINAL_MDR IS NOT NULL
        THEN '(' ||
             TO_CHAR(m.FINAL_MDR , 'FM999990.00') || '%)'

    ELSE NULL
END AS CATEGORY_MCC_MDR
FROM TALY_BO_REP.MMS_MCC_MDR m
WHERE m.ACTIVE_FLAG = 1
ORDER BY m.MCC
